remarks: Easy living in this freshly painted, everything-already-done-for-you rental. Traditional center hall colonial layout with renovated eat-in kitchen, living room with fireplace, dining room, family room, four large bedrooms and 2 1/2 beautiful new bathrooms. Hardwood floors both upstairs and downstairs. There's also a finished lower level perfect for play or exercise. One-car garage, new high efficiency multi zone HVAC. Convenient to absolutely everything: shopping, public transportation, JCC and houses of worship. Both home and location are A++, come see for yourself. Grass and shrubs will be maintained by Landlord. One pet considered on a case by case basis.
